concerns.text: T103's verification ('ls data/raw/ shows only the verified datasets (NAB CSVs and/or UCI fetches per C12)') consumes the output of T104's re-fetch, but T103 is sequenced BEFORE T104. At T103 execution time data/raw cannot yet contain the verified datasets, so the check is unsatisfiable as ordered. Reorder T104 before T103, or scope T103's check to only the deletions (legacy files absent).

concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies section ('T101–T104 ... mostly parallel — different files')
concerns.text: The claimed parallelism of Phase 1 is unsafe: T104 executes 'code/src/data/download_datasets.py', a path that only exists after T102 relocates source files into code/src/; T104 also reads the rewritten config validated by T101; and T103/T104 both mutate data/raw/. T101→T102→T104→T103 (or T103 last) is the actual dependency chain — state it explicitly instead of 'mostly parallel'.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T106 vs T107 (Dependencies: 'T106/T107 can run in parallel after T105')
concerns.text: T106 computes time-to-detection via 'first threshold crossing', but threshold selection on the validation set (FR-019) is owned by T107. Running T106 in parallel with T107 leaves T106 without a defined, pre-selected threshold — a consumer-before-producer on the threshold artifact. Either sequence T107's threshold-selection step before T106, or have T106 explicitly consume the threshold produced by T107's calibrator (C10).

T108 says it measures resources 'over the full pipeline run (T105–T107)' but is listed after T107 completes; clarify whether T108 instruments/wraps the T105–T107 execution (in which case it must be initiated concurrently with T105) or re-runs the pipeline — as written the measurement producer is ambiguous relative to its position in the order.
